module: Topographic map of the minimap. Computes the level bounds from the navgraph nodes (`map.getMap()`), samples the terrain height on a grid (one measurement every 5 m, via `core_terrain.getTerrainHeight`), generates contour lines with the marching squares algorithm, stores them in a spatial tree (`kdtreebox2d`) and can draw them onto the minimap texture. The data is cleared at the start and end of a mission.
notes: BUG: drawContours calls `ui_apps_sdfTopomap.getContourSegments()` and `getContourQuadtree()` instead of `M`; minimap.lua also tests `ui_apps_sdfTopomap`. No 0.40.5 file defines this extension (old name), so the test `if ui_apps_sdfTopomap and ...` fails and the contour lines are never drawn through this path.
The `worldToMapXYZ` parameter of drawContours is not used: the function gets the transform via `ui_apps_minimap_utils.getWorldToMapTransform()`.
drawContours limits drawing to 5000 segments per call and only considers segments within a radius of 200 * scale around the camera. Levels range from 0 to 100; multiples of 10 are drawn thicker.
loadTopoMap chains three steps (bounds, terrain scan, contours) and returns false as soon as one fails; it returns true without redoing anything if the map is already loaded.
Many `log("I", ...)` logs are emitted during generation.

loadTopoMap.desc: Loads the topographic map: navgraph bounds, terrain height grid, then contour lines and spatial tree. No effect (returns true) if already loaded.

returns.desc: true if the map is loaded, false if a step failed.

isLoaded.desc: Indicates whether the topographic map is loaded.

returns.desc: true once loadTopoMap has succeeded, reset to false at each mission start/end.

getHeightmapData.desc: Returns the height grid table (fields `data`, `gridWidth`, `gridHeight` used by the code; empty before loading).

returns.desc: `{minX, maxX, minY, maxY}` in meters (all 0 before loading).

getContourSegments.desc: Returns the list of contour line segments. Each segment is `{level, x1, y1, x2, y2}` (inferred from drawContours).

getContourQuadtree.desc: Returns the `kdtreebox2d` spatial tree indexing the contour segments, or nil if not generated.

drawContours.desc: Draws the contour lines near the camera onto the minimap texture, in the BACKGROUND layer. Gray, lighter the higher the level.

td.desc: Texture drawing object (TextureDrawPrimitive) of the minimap.

scale.desc: Minimap scale in px/m; the query radius is 200 * scale.

worldToMapXYZ.desc: Unused (the transform is reread from ui_apps_minimap_utils).

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a mission/level. Resets the heightmap, the bounds and the contours and marks the map as not loaded.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called at the start of a mission/level. Same reset as onClientEndMission.
